title: So excited to have found this community. My dreams suddenly starting connecting a year ago after a mental break.
content: Hi all, I'm relatively new to browsing reddit communities, my jaw dropped when I stumbled across this group today. I'm going to post some details about my dream world, let me know what sounds familiar and if anything resonates with you. Apologies if this ends up being extremely long. Edit before posting: this may or may not be an absolute schizopost. I love you. Just over a year ago, I experienced a mental episode that landed me in the hospital for a few days. While I was there I mostly slept in my bed as much as I possibly could, waiting for discharge. There was one night that my dream was so vivid I realized I was dreaming and became lucid, woke myself up to take notes on the events of the dream, and went straight back to lucid dreaming in the same world. I can comment or edit with details of that dream if people want, it would be a whole long post in itself. Since then I've regularly returned to the persistent dream world, and as I've come to know it, the Dream City. At first the locations were very spread out and I spent a lot of time driving either on dirt bikes with a group of people through red sandy hills (kind of like Mad Max) or in an old beater truck driving on an interstate highway usually lined with pine trees. We were always together in a group of 5 or 6, either conducting some sort of operation (I don't think I'm an action hero lol but that's what a lot of these dreams were like), or fleeing/hiding from some sort of police/military authority. Some of the persistent locations early on were The Hideout (a cabin in a swamp near the red sands, with a garage for our vehicles. Very green.) The Red Desert (directly connected to the swamp, how to get from swamp to city) The Chinese Hills (extremely steep mountains, people walk on switchback trails holding a wire attached to the mossy mountain face, rich people live in glass houses at the top) The Suburbs (ghetto inner city suburb with broken houses, specifically two houses, a white wood panel early 20th century with roman columns in front and a collapsed gazebo and shed/guest house in back, and one house that was yellow with an unfinished white add-on, perpetually under construction including scaffolding) Downtown (at first I only saw downtown with night sky and bright city lights, almost cyberpunk. The city was split in two levels like a mall lol, except instead of stores on the upper level it was skyscrapers, the upper street was transparent like a light bridge from Halo) --- As time went on, I was more and more intrigued by the connection of my dreams and started keeping notes as often as I could remember to write anything down (which was not often, but often enough to remember small details of many dreams from over a year ago). I noticed that most of the time at the beginning of my dream I was in a place with huge crowds of people, usually an airport or a train station or a cruise ship or, as you all can attest to, an enormous shopping mall. I grew up in Minnesota, I've been to the Mall of America more times than I can count, and the dream mall is like nothing I could have ever imagined. I'm still not confident about this, but I had rationalized that the huge places were all connected and were an intermediary space for people entering the dream world. Like the mall is attached to the airport and train station and parking garage through walkways and escalators. At one point there was a shift, and I stopped conducting operations with the team and started exploring more. Whenever I found myself lucid, I would push the limits of where I could go and what I could do. Very often I would become lucid in the truck on the interstate, usually in the passenger seat with only one member of my crew from before, a large burly masculine figure with deep red skin. Usually wearing a black denim vest or jacket with flannel. Around the time of this shift was a new prominent location and perspective, the highway in the trees would transition to a bridge over an immense body of water, after driving miles out over the water the road would angle to driving straight up 90° for a few hundred feet until we crossed a toll booth that was more like a border crossing, with guards and everything. After crossing the toll booth, the road turned 180° and went straight back down along the same exact path except instead of the forest, it's a gleaming city on the coast made of creamy colored stone. This is already wildly too long so I'll try to brush past a couple more locations and details and see if anyone makes it this far to have comments or questions lol. Dive bar (maybe the most common location for me to start my dreams nowadays, probably because I can meditate on the image of the stairway outside as I fall asleep to bring myself into the dream city) Auditorium/College (connects by spiral stone staircase into system of skyways/walkways between locations) Cafe bakery (there's a restaurant I used to work at many years ago that I still have work dreams about, pretty often I'll become lucid in one of those and find my way to the auditorium or the dive bar)
